scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run cf:config && wrangler deploy -c .wrangler.generated.toml
scripts.db:migrate:local: npm run cf:config && wrangler d1 migrations apply lookthru --local -c .wrangler.generated.toml
scripts.db:migrate: npm run cf:config && wrangler d1 migrations apply lookthru --remote -c .wrangler.generated.toml
